prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation SPRITE SHEET with genuine transparent alpha background, NOT checkerboard. Match reference characters' bold black outlines and flat two-tone cel shading ONLY; no people, weapons, scenery, text, numbers, borders, floor or magenta background. Authentic 1980s Saturday morning cartoon effects, clean hand-inked shapes, no photo texture, no glow filters. Each frame is an isometric battle-map effect seen slightly from above, standing over an INVISIBLE floor diamond occupying the lower 40 percent of its frame. Fixed registration: floor center at 50% width and 80% height, same scale and anchor every frame. Exact uniform grid, equal rectangular cells, each cell aspect ratio 128:160. Keep every frame's artwork within its cell, no overlap. Leave 4% padding around cell edges. Broad ragged scalloped silhouettes, internally solid flat colors, only subtle alpha at outer edges for joining adjacent tiles. 8 consecutive frames in EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, read left to right then next row, canvas 1600x1000. Frame 1 tiny pale yellow flash at floor center; 2 sharp yellow-orange expanding burst; 3 broad orange-yellow fireball filling most cell; 4 maximum billowing fireball with hot yellow center; 5 dark red and charcoal smoke overtakes flame; 6 smoke breaks into lobes; 7 sparse fading charcoal fragments; 8 almost entirely transparent with only two tiny faint smoke flecks. Fireball centered and broad, ragged edges designed to merge visually when placed beside other identical map tiles. No crater or ground.
